# SIDRAH LABS

> Sidrah Labs (سِدْرَة لابس) engineers AI-ready lakehouses and Un-SaaS data migrations today, while forging formal verification infrastructure for tomorrow.

Build data systems you can trust—and change safely.

## What we do

Enterprises are bleeding money on rented pipelines, and their AI pilots are stalling because the underlying legacy data is a fragile mess. We re-architect hostile databases into AI-ready Databricks lakehouses today—while building the deterministic logic firewalls required to safely run AI-paced engineering tomorrow.


## Fixed-scope deployments

- **Legacy ERP to AI-Ready Lakehouse** (A / AI-READINESS) — 14–21 days sprint target.
  95% of AI pilots fail because they are plugged into undocumented, hostile legacy databases. We migrate locked-in SQL/Oracle/ERP silos into a governed Databricks Medallion architecture—delivering a clean, verified Gold layer ready for BI and AI agents.

  Focus: Legacy ERP extraction · Unstructured-to-Delta · AI-ready Gold layer
- **The 'Un-SaaS' Migration (Cost Off-Ramp)** (B / UNSAAS) — 14 days sprint target.
  Stop paying rent on your data. We rip out expensive, metered SaaS connectors (like Fivetran) and replace them with owned, high-performance PySpark pipelines running directly inside your VPC. Slash your monthly data pipeline bills by up to 80% while retaining mathematical source parity.

  Focus: UnSaaS ingestion · Eliminate MAR billing · DBU cost reduction
- **Pipeline Hardening & Logic Firewalls** (C / HARDENING) — 10–14 days sprint target.
  When junior engineers or AI coding agents ship pipeline edits at machine speed, syntax checks pass while silent semantic errors corrupt production. We install explicit schema contracts and deterministic pre-execution gates that physically block destructive SQL before it executes.

  Focus: Schema contracts · Logic firewalls · Golden-SQL evaluation

TIMELINES ARE SPRINT TARGETS; EXACT SCOPE AND PARITY GUARANTEES ARE LOCKED AFTER TECHNICAL DISCOVERY.

## How we deliver

We don't start from a blank repository or bill hours to reinvent standard plumbing. Each sprint deploys our proprietary internal software accelerators directly into your cloud VPC—compounding our delivery speed and your pipeline reliability.

- **Metadata-driven ingestion & UnSaaS kit**: Battle-tested PySpark frameworks for hostile ERP snapshot/merge diffing, high-concurrency API extraction, and zero-row-loss CDC reconciliation.
- **Deterministic DataFrame rules & parity engine**: Modular business-logic harnesses and automated row-hash parity checkers that prove migrated tables mathematically match legacy financial ground truth.
- **Pre-execution schema & logic gates**: Static query analysis, explicit contracts, and evaluation tools that intercept destructive SQL mutations and metric drift before execution.

## Production experience

- **Zero-downtime ERP Lakehouse & metadata ingestion**: Architected and operated an end-to-end Databricks Medallion lakehouse across complex ERP schemas. Engineered a config-driven PySpark snapshot/merge framework (onboarding new tables via config inserts) and automated multi-environment promotion—running in production for 2+ years. (2+ YEARS PRODUCTION)
- **High-concurrency unstructured & HealthAI extraction**: Engineered fault-tolerant extraction infrastructure for a Silicon Valley medical AI team—combining 100+ asynchronous spiders with layout-aware PDF/vision models to turn messy documents into schema-validated analytical tables. (100+ EXTRACTORS / VISION)
- **Symbolic execution & neuro-symbolic verification**: Founded by a Databricks Certified Data Engineer Pro with applied formal-methods research extending JavaPathFinder (JPF) and NeuroSPF symbolic execution harnesses—bridging classical constraint solving with neural/LLM representations. (JPF / NEURO-SYMBOLIC R&D)

## Applied R&D

As automated tools generate software and pipeline logic 240% faster, the enterprise bottleneck shifts from code creation to code trust. Without machine-checked verification, AI-paced engineering carries a poison pill: catastrophic, silent bugs in production.


To capture the real economic velocity of AI, verification must run as fast as generation. Sidrah Labs is developing reusable formal verification infrastructure and neuro-symbolic logic firewalls. By combining relational-algebra compilers with SMT solvers (Z3) and incremental diff engines, we aim to mathematically prove that AI-generated code patches and SQL queries preserve strict business invariants before they ever execute.


THE COMPOUNDING FLYWHEEL: Every enterprise migration we execute exposes real-world failure modes that harden our internal verification harnesses—funding our independence today while forging the standalone verification infrastructure of tomorrow.
